fullDescription: A premium, healthcare-focused fintech dashboard for patient onboarding. Featuring a clean emerald and slate palette, it uses 'General Sans' for modern display typography and 'Satoshi' for body text. The layout is a sophisticated SaaS-style dashboard with a fixed sidebar, sticky header, and a responsive grid system. Highlights include a dark-mode credit wallet card with glassmorphism effects, a three-step onboarding progress tracker, and a bento-style quick actions grid. Ideal for health-tech, fintech, insurance portals, and patient management systems requiring a welcoming but professional entry point.

structured.summary: A clean, trust-inspiring patient portal designed to guide new users through their first financial and medical interactions. It features a high-contrast dark credit card component, a clear progress-based onboarding banner, and a functional sidebar layout using a professional emerald green (#059669) as the primary brand color.

style.description: The style blends high-end fintech aesthetics with medical professionalism. It uses a dual-font system (General Sans for headings, Satoshi for UI/body), a minimalist light gray background (#F8FAFC), and high-quality iconography. Key visual drivers include subtle pulse-glow animations for CTAs, 24px rounded corners for cards, and refined drop shadows.
style.prompt:
Create a design system using 'General Sans' (Display) and 'Satoshi' (Body). Primary Color: Emerald Green (#059669), Secondary Color: Sky Blue (#0369A1). Background: Light Gray (#F8FAFC). Text: Slate-900 (#0F172A) for titles, Slate-500 (#64748B) for body. 

### Card Style
- Border-radius: 24px (1.5rem)
- Border: 1px solid #E2E8F0
- Shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)

### Buttons & Interactions
- Primary Button: #059669 background, white text, 12px padding-x, 16px padding-y, rounded-xl.
- Pulse Animation: `pulse-glow` effect using a 2s ease-in-out cycle that expands a box-shadow (rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.4) to 0 opacity at 12px).
- Hover States: Scale 105% on small news items, background shifts to #047857 for buttons.

### Typography Hierarchy
- Page Titles: General Sans Bold, 32px, tracking -0.02em.
- Card Titles: General Sans Bold, 18px.
- Body Text: Satoshi Medium/Regular, 14px, line-height 1.6.

layout_and_structure.description: A standard sidebar-content architecture. The main content is constrained to a 1152px (max-w-6xl) container for readability, utilizing a modular grid for quick actions and news feeds.

prompts.prompt: Width: 256px (w-64). Background: White. Border-right: 1px solid #E2E8F0. Top: Brand logo with emerald #059669 icon. Nav: Vertical list of items. Active state: #ecfdf5 background, #059669 text, and a 4px right border. Disabled state: #cbd5e1 text, cursor-not-allowed.

Height: 72px. Background: White (semi-opaque with backdrop-blur). Layout: Search bar on left (pill-shaped, #F1F5F9 background, 384px width), user profile and notification bell on right. Profile includes a 40px circular avatar and 2-line text stack (Name/Role).

Full-width white card. Heading with rocket icon. Three steps horizontal layout. Step 1 (Active): Emerald circle, pulse-glow, bold text. Step 2 & 3 (Inactive): Gray background (#E2E8F0), slate text. Steps are connected by a subtle chevron icon or line.

High-contrast dark card using a linear gradient: from-slate-700 via-slate-800 to-slate-900. Padding: 32px. Center align available balance (Ksh 0.00) in 48px font size. Below balance, place a primary 'Apply for Credit Now' button with a pulse-glow effect. Add glassmorphism decorative circles (blur-3xl) in corners for depth.

4-column grid (2-column mobile). Card type: Vertical orientation with large 56px icon containers. Highlight the primary action ('Apply') with emerald background and ring-2 ring-emerald-400. Other active actions use white background. Disabled actions use 50% opacity and #F1F5F9 backgrounds.

Center-aligned content within a white card. Minimum height: 320px. Icon: 80px gray circle with wallet icon. Headline: 18px Bold. Description: Max-width 320px, Slate-500. CTA: Emerald button with compass icon.

special_ui_components.description: A high-attention button used for primary onboarding conversion.
special_ui_components.prompt: Background: #059669. Padding: 16px 32px. Border-radius: 12px. Box-shadow: `0 0 0 0 rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.4)` animating to `0 0 0 12px rgba(5, 150, 105, 0)` over 2 seconds. Icon: lucide:plus-circle on left of text.

special_ui_components.description: Horizontal card with image for editorial content.
special_ui_components.prompt: Flex container. Left: 80x80px rounded-xl image with object-cover. Right: Text stack. Tag: Uppercase 10px bold emerald text. Title: 14px bold, line-clamp-1. Interaction: Image scales to 110% within container on card hover.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Use specific font pairing (General Sans/Satoshi) to maintain the tech-forward medical feel. MUST: Maintain a strict #059669 color for all success/primary actions. MUST NOT: Use generic rounded corners; specifically use 24px (1.5rem) for main cards to create the soft, premium feel. MUST: Ensure disabled states are clearly visual-locked with 50% opacity to prevent user frustration.
